Research Methodology

A Systematic Approach to Data Analysis

Objective: To establish a rigorous framework for analyzing large-scale datasets using mixed methods.

Methodology Overview:

  1. Data Collection: Structured surveys and semi-structured interviews
  2. Quantitative Analysis: Statistical modeling with regression and ANOVA
  3. Qualitative Analysis: Thematic coding using grounded theory approach
  4. Validation: Triangulation across multiple data sources

Note: All protocols approved by the Institutional Review Board (IRB-2025-0047).
